items.text: The prefix "**за**-" implies the following meaning:
points: Getting (disappearing) behind something — **заходить**, **зайти за** + Acc.: **Солнце заходит за облака**. **Автомашина заезжает за дом**.
Dropping in on somebody or stopping by at a certain place: **заходить**, **зайти** — **в магазин**, **на почту**, **к учителю**.

Dropping in or stopping by to fetch something or someone — **заходить**, **зайти за** + Instr.: **Я зайду за вами**. — I'll stop by to pick you up. **Он зашёл за книгой**. — He dropped in to pick up the book. Also note the combination of subparagraphs (b) and (c): **Он зашёл ко мне за книгой**. — He stopped by at my place to pick up the book. **Я заехал на почту за письмами**. — I stopped by at the post office to get my mail.

prepositional phrases
rows: **за-** — Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way

Старушка зашла за угол и исчезла. — The old woman walked behind the corner and disappeared. Other: 1. Action performed on the way to a destination: По дороге домой я зашла в магазин за хлебом. — On the way home I stopped at the store for bread. 2. A short visit: Молодой человек часто заходит к маме. — The young man often stops by his mother's place. 3. Movement deep into something, at a great distance (inside, upwards or downwards): Мяч залетел на крышу дома. — The ball flew onto the roof of the house.
в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst.
**за-** (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion
Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room.
